description: This file defines the EndpointDefinitionProvider class within the Aws\EndpointV2 namespace. It provides static methods for retrieving endpoint rulesets and tests, managing data files for AWS service endpoint resolution and testing.

classes.name: EndpointDefinitionProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving AWS endpoint rules and tests, and managing related data files.

methods.name: getEndpointRuleset
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint ruleset data for a specified AWS service and API version.

methods.name: getEndpointTests
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint test data for a specified AWS service and API version.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Returns partition data related to AWS endpoints, either from a PHP file or JSON.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve specific endpoint-related data files based on service, API version, and type.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Returns the latest API version for a given AWS service.
